A look inside

Warm wood, green tiles, framed art and plenty of plants.

4.4

Loved by 1,341 Google reviewers

Also rated 4.6 on Zomato and 4.3 on Tripadvisor.

Guests praise the coffee, pastries and desserts, with the Mudslide and Suisse Forest Cake mentioned most.

The ambience is described as pleasant, classy and well kept, with friendly, attentive staff.

Some reviewers note that service can be slow when it’s busy, so book ahead for evenings.
